title: Evaluating the Stability of Semantic Concept Representations in CNNs for Robust Explainability
reasoning: The paper discusses transparency, safety, and fairness as motivations for Explainable AI (XAI) in safety-critical systems, citing regulatory demands (e.g., ISO26262, GDPR, EU AI Act). However, its core contribution is a technical framework for evaluating the stability of concept representations in CNNs, not a direct evaluation or benchmarking of ethical reasoning, moral frameworks, or faith within AI systems.
